projects.notes: VDOT Six-Year Improvement Program (SYIP) approved projects. HAS_PE / HAS_RW / HAS_CN flag preliminary-engineering, right-of-way and construction phases; PE_START_DATE, RW_START_DATE, CN_START_DATE, CN_END_DATE are phase dates; CURRENT_PE_ESTIMATE / CURRENT_RW_ESTIMATE / CURRENT_CN_ESTIMATE and TOTAL_EST_CURRENT are cost estimates. Planned vs under construction: POOL_PRJ_STATUS_DSC (see values) and CN_START_DATE in the future. HAS_RW='1' with a future RW_START_DATE marks upcoming right-of-way acquisition.

parcels_counties.notes: Prince William County open-data parcels joined to CAMA; 156,428 of 160,086 rows have an owner (names look truncated at about 30 characters). The CAMA_ADDRESS*/CAMA_CITY/STATE/ZIPCODE fields appear to be the owner's mailing address (not confirmed by documentation). No value field.

Chesterfield County 'ParcelsEnriched' layer (county ArcGIS Online org); 150,861 of 151,015 rows have OwnerName (rows without it are non-parcel polygons with all-null attributes). TotalAssessment also present.

City of Richmond (ArcGIS Online account richmondvagis) 'Parcels', parcel geometry joined to assessor CAMA ownership; data last edited 2026-11-14. Terms read: the item's licence text is only 'No warranty is expressed or implied regarding the use of this data, nor does the act of distribution constitute any such warranty.' (https://www.arcgis.com/home/item.html?id=fbfce2aab2a44c05bc0abc2d6ea7e54a); no commercial or solicitation limit stated there. Parcels with several ownership records are stacked (one polygon per PIN; CountOfPIN). AsrLocationBldgNo is the building number only (no street-name field); LandSqFt is square feet, not acres. LandValue, DwellingValue, Mailable and MaskedOwner fields also present. A 200 m point query downtown returned 771 rows.

parcels_counties.notes: Albemarle County's own ArcGIS Online organisation ('Albemarle County, VA', account AGOL_Data_Publisher), item 'Parcels' (aa56c3e06a344f1c8a40b109dfbb4076), service name redacted_parcels; data last edited 2026-11-16, described as updated weekly. owner filled on 51,020 of 51,030 rows; owner2 second owner; ownermailingaddress holds the three mailing fields joined; gpin, landvalue, improvementsvalue, lastsaleprice also present. Terms read in the item's licence field (https://www.arcgis.com/sharing/rest/content/items/aa56c3e06a344f1c8a40b109dfbb4076?f=json): 'This data is provided by Albemarle County for informational and general reference purposes. Users may view, download, and use the data for lawful purposes, subject to applicable laws, regulations, and County policies.' followed by a warranty disclaimer; the item description's 'USE CONSTRAINTS' says only that it is 'intended for general informational, mapping, planning, property research, and reference purposes' and is not a survey. No limit on commercial use, redistribution, solicitation or mailing lists is stated; the 'County policies' it refers to were not located. The description says 'Selected attributes or records are redacted from this dataset in accordance with applicable County requirements'. A second public service in the same organisation (Parcels/FeatureServer/0, 50,870 rows, item titled 'Parcels (redacted)', a static copy last edited June 2026 with an empty licence) was not used.

James City County's own server, layer 'Parcels' in JCC/GIS_Data; ArcGIS item 'James City County, VA - Parcels' (a0dfa59d3c4a442c9ebe3719762a407d, account khazelwood, modified 2026-11-19). Owner1 filled on 36,365 of 36,479 rows; Owner2 second owner; LocAddr/LocCity/LocZip are the assessor's site address; CurLand, CurImp, Sale1D, Sale1Amt, Grantor1 also present. Terms read in the item's licence field (https://www.arcgis.com/sharing/rest/content/items/a0dfa59d3c4a442c9ebe3719762a407d?f=json): 'All Data is believed to be correct, but is not guaranteed by James City County (JCC). As such, JCC is not responsible for its accuracy or how current it may be. ... Disclaimers as to such should be placed on all final products derived from the provided data.' No limit on commercial use, redistribution, solicitation or mailing lists is stated; the one condition is that an accuracy disclaimer be carried on derived products.

City of Charlottesville's own server, open-data layer 'Parcel Area Details 2 bu' (polygons); ArcGIS item 'Parcel Details 2' (c609cc24d9944821a0b00fd343ba824c, account CharlottesvilleAdmin). summary: VDOT's SYIP approved-projects line and point layers verify with status, scope, cost and right-of-way/construction phase dates. The VGIN statewide parcel layer (https://vginmaps.vdem.virginia.gov/arcgis/rest/services/VA_Base_Layers/VA_Parcels/FeatureServer/0, 4,174,364 parcels, verified) has only FIPS, LOCALITY, PARCELID, no owner. Owner names verified for Prince William and Chesterfield only; Fairfax's open-data parcel layer has no owner fields, and the Loudoun, Virginia Beach and Henrico servers timed out from the research network. On 2026-11-20 nine more locality owner layers were verified and recorded: Albemarle, James City, Fauquier, Franklin County and Charlottesville with no use limit in the terms read, and York, Pittsylvania and Lynchburg (terms not found) and Roanoke City (reproduction needs the city's authorization; 2023 snapshot) held.
parcels_second_pass: Second pass 2026-11-17 (parcels only). Statewide: unchanged, VGIN statewide parcels have no owner. Added Richmond city, Hanover, Loudoun, Roanoke County, Newport News, Chesapeake (2020 snapshot). NOT FOUND: FAIRFAX - no public layer with owner names: county ArcGIS Online Parcels (services1.arcgis.com/ioennV6PpG5Xodq0/.../Parcels/FeatureServer/0, 369,686 rows) has only PIN; www.fairfaxcounty.gov/mercator/.../GIS/ParcelsPlus/MapServer/0 has only PIN; the Tax Administration Real Estate tables (Legal, Parcels, Sales, Assessed Values) are keyed by PARID with site address and values but no owner field, and being tables they take no spatial query. ARLINGTON - arlgis.arlingtonva.us/arcgis/rest/services/StaffMap/Property_Map_public/MapServer/3 answers spatial queries and has the owner MAILING address (OWN_STREET, OWN_CITY, OWN_STATE, OWN_ZIP) and values but NO owner-name field; open-data REA Property Polygons has only RPCMSTR. SPOTSYLVANIA - county SpotsyParcels layer (70,181 rows) has parcel ids only, no owner; county server timed out. NORFOLK - ArcGIS Online Parcels layer has only GPIN/TAX_ACCT; gisshare.norfolk.gov timed out. VIRGINIA BEACH (geo.vbgov.com Basemaps/Property_Information/MapServer/12), HENRICO (portal.henrico.gov Layers/Tax_Parcels_and_CAMA_Data_External), AUGUSTA (gis.co.augusta.va.us): services are listed in ArcGIS Online but every request from the research network timed out or was refused, so nothing is verified; the only reachable Henrico layer with owners is a 735-row county-owned extract from 2022. Third-party re-uploads of county parcels by unrelated accounts were ignored.
